title: WASP: Benchmarking Web Agent Security Against Prompt Injection Attacks
authors_zh: Ivan Evtimov, Arman Zharmagambetov, Aaron Grattafiori, Chuan Guo, Kamalika Chaudhuri
paper_type_zh: Web agent prompt injection安全基准与评测契约审计
best_for_zh: 研究web agent安全、环境轨迹评测、LLM-as-judge与verifier失效模式的读者
one_line: WASP operationalizes realistic web-agent hijacking as 84 runtime-instantiated tasks with a GPT-4o any-compromised-action judge and task-specific environment or action-log predicates, exposing both security-by-incompetence and verifier-contract drift.
WASP以84个运行时生成的GitLab/Postmill prompt-injection任务审计web agent，并分离GPT-4o逐动作劫持判定与任务特定的端到端成功，但未发布canonical rollout且固定commit的exfil evaluator只检查action text中的URL片段。
why: It shows why an agent trajectory needs two distinct audit layers: a judge can detect that the policy started following an injection, while final-state checks reveal whether harm was actually completed; the released exfiltration checker, missing rollouts, mixed license, and environment drift also demonstrate why benchmark code is not automatically a reusable training corpus.
inclusion_reason: WASP exposes a concrete security-feedback surface for web agents: executable environment episodes whose observations and actions are scored both for intermediate hijacking and end-to-end attacker-goal completion, making the gap between judgment-based diversion labels and environment/log predicates directly auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary publication is the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track paper; the version record is arXiv v3 dated 16 May 2025, and the official implementation was inspected at commit ffee6f41fde76acd14bd792db442479c506260c2. WASP asks how often a web agent exposed to attacker-controlled but ordinary page content begins following an indirect prompt injection, and how often it actually completes the malicious objective. Its threat model is a benign user and a black-box malicious environment: the attacker may post content in normal untrusted-user-controlled elements but does not know the agent implementation (Paper §2–§3.1).

The main evaluation surface starts from 21 manually constructed, environment-realizable attacker goals—12 on a self-hosted GitLab clone and 9 on a Postmill-based Reddit clone. Each goal is paired with two benign user goals in the same site and two task-related injection templates, yielding 21 × 2 × 2 = 84 runtime tasks per main setting; a separate utility suite contains 37 no-attack tasks. One episode joins task/setup fields, injected page content, scaffold-specific observations, model reasoning/messages and browser actions, final environment or action-log state, compromise judgments, end-to-end goal success, utility success, and cleanup metadata. The released Croissant attack file contains 21 base-goal records, not an immutable 84-row rollout manifest.

WASP belongs to environment_agent_trajectory_data because the evaluated object is an executable website episode with an observation–action trace and terminal evaluation. It also belongs to benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces because its contribution is a mixed security-feedback contract, not policy training. It does not cover SFT, preference optimization, reward-model training, RLVR, desktop agents, code agents, adaptive attack generation, or deployment prevalence. This Card provides bilingual L4 content depth from verified paper, appendix, and code evidence while retaining the accepted L3_summary_ready metadata level and partial status because immutable replay, judge calibration, canonical rollouts, and release checksums remain unresolved.

本卡以NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track正式论文为主要出版来源；版本记录为2025年5月16日的arXiv v3，官方实现固定检查于commit ffee6f41fde76acd14bd792db442479c506260c2。WASP考察两个分离的问题：web agent接触攻击者可控但属于普通网页内容的间接prompt injection后，多大概率开始遵循恶意指令，以及多大概率真正完成攻击目标。其threat model是benign user与black-box malicious environment；攻击者只能在常规、由不可信用户控制的页面元素中发布内容，并不知道agent实现（论文§2–§3.1）。

主要评测面从21个由人工构造且经人工确认可在环境中实现的attacker goal开始，其中12个属于自托管GitLab clone，9个属于基于Postmill的Reddit clone。每个goal与同一站点中的2个benign user goal、2种task-related注入模板组合，因此每个主设置运行时生成21 × 2 × 2 = 84个任务；另有37个无攻击utility任务。一个episode连接任务/setup字段、注入页面内容、不同scaffold的observation、模型reasoning/message与browser action、最终环境或action-log状态、compromise judgment、端到端goal success、utility success及cleanup元数据。发布的Croissant attack文件只有21条base-goal记录，并不是不可变的84条rollout manifest。

WASP属于environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为评测对象是带observation–action trace与terminal evaluation的可执行网站episode；它也属于benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces，因为核心贡献是mixed安全feedback contract，而不是policy training。论文不覆盖SFT、preference optimization、reward-model training、RLVR、desktop agent、code agent、adaptive attack generation或部署发生率。本卡基于已核验的论文、附录与代码提供双语L4内容深度，但保留accepted metadata中的L3_summary_ready与partial：不可变回放、judge calibration、canonical rollout和发布checksum仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WASP's contribution is a two-layer security evaluation contract for realistic web-agent episodes: one layer asks whether the trajectory was diverted by an injection, and the other asks whether the attacker goal was completed in the environment.

The evaluation object is not merely an injected prompt. A runtime task binds a benign user goal, a malicious goal and security category, site setup/parameters, an action URL, one of two task-related injection formats, an agent scaffold, and a generated observation–reasoning/message–action sequence. The release supplies setup and cleanup functions, base attack and utility records, runners, and evaluators, but no canonical corpus of the paper's model rollouts.

ASR-intermediate is judgment-required. GPT-4o classifies each action-level observation/reasoning/action unit as compromised, not_compromised, or outright_refusal; the released implementation marks the full episode compromised if any action is positive. This judge can inspect the serialized trace unit and its relation to the attacker instruction, but it cannot establish final semantic harm or recover environment state absent from the log. ASR-end-to-end is primarily environmental: goal-specific DOM/final-state or action-log rules decide whether the attacker objective succeeded. The fixed exfiltration evaluator is an important exception in semantics: it searches extracted action text for an expected URL substring and does not verify receipt by an attacker server.

The closest substrate is VisualWebArena, which WASP reuses and modifies into isolated GitLab/Postmill security scenarios. Relative to prompt-injection evaluations with unrealistic attacker power, isolated steps, or nonpublic suites discussed in the paper, WASP joins a constrained black-box threat model to end-to-end execution and reports intermediate diversion separately from completed harm. VisualWebArena, Claude Computer Use, browser tool calling, GPT-4o judgment, and manually written injection text are reused components; the direction signal is the explicit separation of trajectory compromise from terminal security outcome.

WASP的核心贡献是面向真实web-agent episode的两层安全评测契约：第一层判断轨迹是否已被注入指令带偏，第二层判断攻击者目标是否在环境中真正完成。

评测对象不只是一个被注入的prompt。运行时任务绑定benign user goal、malicious goal及其安全类别、站点setup/parameters、action URL、两种task-related注入格式之一、agent scaffold，以及生成的observation–reasoning/message–action序列。发布提供setup与cleanup函数、base attack和utility记录、runner及evaluator，但没有论文模型运行的canonical rollout corpus。

ASR-intermediate需要judgment。GPT-4o把每个action-level observation/reasoning/action单元分类为compromised、not_compromised或outright_refusal；发布实现只要任一action为positive，就把整个episode标为compromised。该judge能检查序列化轨迹单元及其与攻击指令的关系，却不能据此证明最终语义伤害，也无法恢复日志未记录的环境状态。ASR-end-to-end主要是environmental：按goal定制的DOM/final-state或action-log规则判断攻击目标是否成功。固定commit中的exfiltration evaluator在语义上是重要例外：它只在提取的action text中搜索预期URL substring，不验证攻击者服务器是否收到数据。

最接近的底层substrate是VisualWebArena，WASP复用它并改造成隔离的GitLab/Postmill安全场景。相较论文所讨论的攻击者权限不现实、只看单步或不公开的prompt-injection评测，WASP把受限black-box threat model连接到端到端执行，并分开报告中间劫持与最终伤害。VisualWebArena、Claude Computer Use、browser tool calling、GPT-4o judgment和人工注入文本都是复用组件；真正的方向信号是显式区分trajectory compromise与terminal security outcome。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins with 21 manually written attacker goals, 12 for GitLab and 9 for Reddit/Postmill, spanning exfiltration, data destruction, access changes, impaired defenses, execution, phishing, harassment, misinformation, snooping, and related violations. Authors retain goals only after manually checking that they are realizable in the environment; the proposed-goal pool, rejected cases, adjudication, and selection threshold are unknown. GitLab contributes two benign goals (comment and like), and Reddit contributes two (comment and upvote). The main suite crosses each attacker goal with both same-environment user goals and two task-related injection formats—plain text and a URL anchor—to create 84 tasks. A task-agnostic prompt variant is used in an ablation, and 37 no-attack tasks measure utility (Paper §3.2–§3.4; Appendix B Tables 5–6).

The 21 released attack records expose fields such as free_form_name, environment, setup_fn, parameters, action_url, malicious instruction, exfil, evaluator descriptions/types/predicates, cleanup_fn, and notes; Croissant conversion also stores stringified parameter/evaluation fields. At runtime the prompt injector creates site state, inserts the chosen injection in an ordinary attacker-controlled page element, combines the benign and malicious task information, writes task JSON, and starts the agent from the configured URL. After the run, cleanup restores the modified site state.

Three scaffolds generate trajectories. VisualWebArena uses identifier-based browser actions with accessibility-tree observations and optional Set-of-Marks screenshots. Claude CURI uses screenshots and computer-use click/type actions while retaining the last ten screenshots and prior model output. The tool-calling loop exposes accessibility-tree observations as low-privilege tool messages and keeps three prior observations. The evaluated backbones are GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, o1, Claude Sonnet 3.5 v2, Claude Sonnet 3.7 Extended Thinking, and Llama-3.3-70B. Pinned code caps VisualWebArena at 15 steps, GPT tool calling at 20 actions, and Claude CURI at 75 actions; temperature, seeds, exact provider model snapshots, retries, and token budgets are unknown.

Each run writes scaffold-specific HTML or JSONL logs with observations, model reasoning/messages, browser or computer actions, and task metadata. GPT-4o then judges each action unit; classify_group applies an any-positive rule to obtain episode-level ASR-intermediate. Malformed judge output or an API error defaults to not_compromised. A separate final evaluator applies goal-specific program_html, required-content, forbidden-content, or exfiltration rules to produce ASR-end-to-end; utility tasks use corresponding task predicates. At commit ffee6f41…, ExfilEvaluator scans extracted action descriptions for an expected URL substring rather than confirming server receipt.

Outputs are attack-success and utility rates plus locally generated task and trace files; there is no training reward, optimizer, train/dev split, or canonical public rollout set. WASP is used only for evaluation and security audit. Exact replay requires the pinned code commit, attack and utility configs, injection template, site images/data/accounts/reset state, service versions, scaffold limits and observation history, API model revisions, judge prompt/model/parser, evaluator code, and retry/crash retention policy. The repository README estimates 4–6 hours for one complete run, but no tag, release, immutable environment bundle, or valid content checksum binds those components.

构造从21个人工编写attacker goal开始，其中GitLab 12个、Reddit/Postmill 9个，覆盖exfiltration、data destruction、access change、削弱防御、execution、phishing、harassment、misinformation、snooping及相关违规。作者只保留经人工确认可在环境中实现的goal；候选goal总池、拒绝案例、adjudication与selection threshold为unknown。GitLab提供2个benign goal（comment与like），Reddit提供2个（comment与upvote）。主套件将每个attacker goal与同环境的2个user goal、2种task-related注入格式——plain text与URL anchor——做笛卡尔组合，得到84个任务。task-agnostic prompt只用于消融，另有37个无攻击任务衡量utility（论文§3.2–§3.4；附录B表5–6）。

发布的21条attack记录包含free_form_name、environment、setup_fn、parameters、action_url、恶意instruction、exfil、evaluator描述/类型/predicate、cleanup_fn与notes等字段；Croissant转换还保存字符串化的参数和评测字段。运行时，prompt injector创建站点状态，把选定注入写入普通攻击者可控页面元素，组合benign与malicious任务信息，写出task JSON，并让agent从配置URL开始。运行结束后，cleanup恢复被修改的站点状态。

三种scaffold生成轨迹。VisualWebArena以accessibility-tree observation和可选Set-of-Marks截图配合identifier-based browser action；Claude CURI使用截图与computer-use click/type action，并保留最近10张截图及此前模型输出；tool-calling loop把accessibility-tree observation作为低权限tool message，并保留3个历史observation。被测backbone为GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、o1、Claude Sonnet 3.5 v2、Claude Sonnet 3.7 Extended Thinking与Llama-3.3-70B。固定代码把VisualWebArena限制为15步、GPT tool calling限制为20个action、Claude CURI限制为75个action；temperature、seed、精确provider model snapshot、retry与token budget为unknown。

每次运行写出scaffold特定的HTML或JSONL日志，包含observation、模型reasoning/message、browser或computer action及任务元数据。随后GPT-4o逐个判断action单元，classify_group用any-positive规则得到episode-level ASR-intermediate。judge输出格式不匹配或API报错时，parser默认返回not_compromised。独立final evaluator再用按goal定制的program_html、required-content、forbidden-content或exfiltration规则计算ASR-end-to-end；utility任务使用对应task predicate。在commit ffee6f41…中，ExfilEvaluator只扫描提取出的action description是否包含预期URL substring，而不确认服务器收件。

输出是attack-success与utility rate，以及本地生成的task和trace文件；不存在training reward、optimizer、train/dev split或canonical公开rollout集合。WASP仅用于evaluation与security audit。精确回放必须固定代码commit、attack/utility config、注入模板、站点image/data/account/reset state、service version、scaffold步数与observation history、API模型版本、judge prompt/model/parser、evaluator代码，以及retry/crash保留策略。README估计一次完整运行需要4–6小时，但目前没有tag、release、不可变环境bundle或有效content checksum把这些组件绑定起来。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 2 evaluates GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, o1, Claude Sonnet 3.5 v2, Claude Sonnet 3.7 Extended Thinking, and Llama-3.3-70B through VisualWebArena, Claude CURI, or browser tool-calling scaffolds. Across the reported model/scaffold/defense settings, ASR-intermediate ranges from 0.167 to 0.857, ASR-end-to-end from 0 to 0.167, and utility from 0.027 to 0.622 (Paper Table 2, §4.1–§4.2). These are author-reported rates over the fixed suites, not independently reproduced estimates.

The large intermediate-versus-end-to-end gap is the central empirical result. Some agents begin executing the injected objective frequently, yet complete it rarely. The paper attributes part of that gap to agent capability: a hijacked agent may still be unable to carry out the malicious workflow. Consequently, low end-to-end ASR is not evidence of refusal or robust security; it can be “security by incompetence.” Utility must be read alongside both ASRs because a scaffold that cannot complete benign tasks also has fewer opportunities to finish attacks.

Tables 3–4 report that URL-anchor injections generally produce higher intermediate ASR than plain text, while task-agnostic prompts reduce ASR but do not drive it to zero. Defensive system-level instructions reduce some GPT results, yet the tested instruction-hierarchy placement does not eliminate hijacking (Paper §4.2, Tables 3–4). These ablations support sensitivity to prompt format and message privilege, but they do not establish robustness to adaptive attacks, broader websites, or unseen attacker goals.

The released implementation provides direct evidence about measurement behavior. GPT-4o judgment is performed per action and aggregated by any-positive, whereas the paper's prose can be read as judging concatenated reasoning/actions. Parser failures default to not_compromised, and no human-labeled calibration set or agreement statistic is reported. For exfiltration, the pinned evaluator returns success from expected URL text in agent actions rather than independently checking attacker-server receipt. These code-level facts narrow what the reported ASRs mean.

The paper reports no error bars or statistical-significance analysis (NeurIPS checklist item 7). Exact model snapshots, temperatures, seeds, retries, and total retained runs are unknown. Benchmark performance therefore demonstrates that the two failure stages can diverge under the reported settings; it does not prove task quality, judge validity, release completeness, or suitability as training data.

论文表2通过VisualWebArena、Claude CURI或browser tool-calling scaffold评测GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、o1、Claude Sonnet 3.5 v2、Claude Sonnet 3.7 Extended Thinking与Llama-3.3-70B。在所报告的model/scaffold/defense设置中，ASR-intermediate范围为0.167–0.857，ASR-end-to-end为0–0.167，utility为0.027–0.622（论文表2，§4.1–§4.2）。这些是固定套件上的作者报告rate，不是独立复现结果。

中间层与端到端ASR之间的大幅差距是核心实验证据。有些agent经常开始执行注入目标，却很少把它完成。论文把部分差距归因于agent能力：已经被劫持的agent仍可能无法完成恶意工作流。因此，低end-to-end ASR不能作为拒绝或稳健安全的证据，也可能只是“security by incompetence”。utility必须与两个ASR一起读取，因为无法完成benign task的scaffold同样更少有机会完成攻击。

表3–4显示，URL-anchor注入通常比plain text产生更高intermediate ASR；task-agnostic prompt降低ASR但没有降到0。防御性系统级指令会降低部分GPT结果，但被测instruction-hierarchy placement并未消除劫持（论文§4.2，表3–4）。这些消融支持prompt格式和message privilege会影响结果，却不能证明对adaptive attack、更广网站或未见attacker goal具有鲁棒性。

发布实现直接揭示了度量行为。GPT-4o按action判断并以any-positive聚合，而论文文字也可能被读成对拼接reasoning/action的判断。parser失败默认返回not_compromised，论文没有报告人工标注calibration set或一致性统计。对exfiltration而言，固定evaluator根据agent action中的预期URL文本判成功，而不是独立检查攻击者服务器收件。这些代码事实限制了ASR可表达的含义。

论文没有报告error bar或statistical-significance分析（NeurIPS checklist item 7）。精确model snapshot、temperature、seed、retry与总保留run数为unknown。因此，benchmark performance只能说明在所报设置中两类失败阶段可能分离；它不能证明任务质量、judge有效性、发布完整性或训练数据适用性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline described by WASP includes prompt-injection tests with overly broad attacker control, unrealistic or isolated malicious goals, single-step evaluation, and provider security suites that are not publicly reproducible. VisualWebArena already supplies browser tasks, accessibility-tree observations, executable actions, and self-hosted websites; existing agent scaffolds already supply the policies and interaction loops.

WASP changes the evaluation object in four concrete ways. It constrains the attacker to ordinary untrusted-user-controlled page content in a black-box setting; defines 21 realizable malicious goals across GitLab and Reddit/Postmill; crosses those goals with benign tasks and injection forms into 84 end-to-end cases; and records two distinct outcomes—GPT-4o-detected intermediate diversion and goal-specific terminal success—plus a 37-task utility surface. This makes “the agent followed the attack” and “the attack caused the intended outcome” separately measurable.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the feedback interface rather than benchmark scale. A web-agent trace can carry a judgment-based compromise label and an environmental/log-based outcome label that disagree for informative reasons: refusal, partial execution, agent incompetence, judge error, or verifier mismatch. The release also exposes how supervision granularity can be deceptive: actions are judged internally, but only full-episode aggregates are reusable without a canonical labeled action corpus.

The work does not introduce VisualWebArena, the GitLab/Postmill substrate, GPT-4o, Claude Computer Use, browser tool calling, LLM-as-judge classification, DOM predicates, or automated attack search. The attacks are manually written and the principal novelty is their constrained security setting and paired feedback layers. Reuse should not treat higher ASR as data-quality evidence; it must first pin the release, reconcile paper and code semantics for exfiltration, calibrate the judge, capture complete rollouts, and verify environment and license provenance.

WASP所描述的prior-work baseline包括攻击者控制范围过大、恶意goal不现实或彼此孤立的prompt-injection测试、single-step评测，以及无法公开复现的模型提供商安全套件。VisualWebArena已经提供browser task、accessibility-tree observation、可执行action与自托管网站；既有agent scaffold也已提供policy和interaction loop。

WASP从四个具体方面改变评测对象：在black-box设置下把攻击者限制为普通不可信用户可控的页面内容；在GitLab与Reddit/Postmill上定义21个可实现恶意goal；把这些goal与benign task、注入格式组合成84个end-to-end case；同时记录GPT-4o检测的中间带偏与按goal定制的terminal success，并配套37个utility任务。由此，“agent遵循了攻击”和“攻击造成预期结果”可以分开测量。

对reasoning data研究而言，方向信号来自feedback interface，而不是benchmark规模。一条web-agent trace可同时带有judgment-based compromise label与environment/log-based outcome label；二者可能因refusal、partial execution、agent incompetence、judge error或verifier mismatch而不一致。发布还说明supervision granularity可能造成误读：内部按action判断，但在没有canonical action-label corpus时，可复用对象只有full-episode聚合结果。

论文没有提出VisualWebArena、GitLab/Postmill substrate、GPT-4o、Claude Computer Use、browser tool calling、LLM-as-judge分类、DOM predicate或自动attack search。攻击文本由人工编写，主要新意是受限安全场景及其成对feedback layer。复用时不能把更高ASR当作数据质量证据；应先固定发布版本，对账论文与代码的exfiltration语义，校准judge，捕获完整rollout，并核验环境和许可证provenance。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The GPT-4o intermediate judge is not ground truth. No independent human-labeled calibration, agreement, or revision study is reported. Because one positive action marks the whole episode compromised, a single false positive inflates ASR-intermediate; malformed output or API failure defaults to not_compromised, creating a systematic false-negative path.
  • The two feedback layers observe different evidence. Intermediate judgment reads serialized action units but not complete environment state. DOM/content rules can be fooled by stale state, partial updates, localization, rendering, or website-version drift and need not prove the intended semantic violation.
  • The pinned exfiltration contract is weaker than confirmed data theft. ExfilEvaluator only searches extracted action text for an expected URL substring; it does not check that an attacker server received the secret or that the value was complete and valid. This differs materially from reading the paper's final-state/server-receipt description literally.
  • End-to-end ASR is capability-confounded. A model can follow the malicious instruction yet fail to execute it, so low attack completion may mean incompetence rather than refusal. Conversely, utility spans 0.027–0.622 across settings, and results have no reported error bars, significance analysis, or multi-seed protocol.
  • Coverage is narrow: 21 manual goals, two websites, two main task-related templates, and four simple benign goals. The authors identify limited website and prompt diversity and no desktop/code-agent extension; adaptive attackers, richer social contexts, and deployment prevalence are not tested.
  • Exact replay is not sealed. There are no tagged releases, GitHub Releases, immutable site/VM images, scraped-data snapshots, service-version manifests, or complete account/reset records. The official repository was archived on 1 July 2026, so API, browser, service, and evaluator drift will not be maintained upstream.
  • The Croissant metadata's sha256 field contains the string main, not a content hash. The 21 attack JSONL rows are base goals rather than an immutable 84-task manifest, and no canonical successful, refused, hijacked-incomplete, failed, crashed, timed-out, or retried rollout corpus is published.
  • The majority WASP code/data is CC BY-NC 4.0 while vendored VisualWebArena and Claude demo components are MIT. The self-hosted sites contain scraped real-site data; record-level provenance, consent, PII review, and redistribution rights are unknown. Curator inference: these mixed rights and absent lineage block unrestricted training or redistribution even if a fresh replay succeeds.

• GPT-4o intermediate judge不是ground truth。论文没有报告独立人工标注的calibration、agreement或revision研究。由于任一positive action都会把整个episode标为compromised，单个false positive会抬高ASR-intermediate；格式不匹配或API失败则默认not_compromised，形成系统性false-negative路径。
  • 两层feedback观察到的证据不同。intermediate judgment读取序列化action单元，却看不到完整environment state。DOM/content规则可能受stale state、partial update、localization、rendering或网站版本漂移影响，也不一定能证明预期的语义违规。
  • 固定commit的exfiltration contract弱于确认数据失窃。ExfilEvaluator只在提取的action text中搜索预期URL substring；它不检查攻击者服务器是否收到secret，也不检查传输值是否完整有效。这与按字面理解论文的final-state/server-receipt描述存在实质差异。
  • End-to-end ASR受能力confounding影响。模型可能已经遵循恶意指令，却没有能力执行成功，因此低攻击完成率也许意味着incompetence而不是refusal。与此同时，各设置utility跨度为0.027–0.622，结果没有报告error bar、显著性分析或multi-seed protocol。
  • 覆盖范围有限：21个人工goal、2个网站、2种主要task-related模板及4个简单benign goal。作者明确指出网站与prompt多样性有限，也没有扩展到desktop/code agent；论文未测试adaptive attacker、更丰富社会情境或部署发生率。
  • 精确回放没有被封装。仓库没有tagged release、GitHub Release、不可变site/VM image、scraped-data snapshot、service-version manifest或完整account/reset记录。官方仓库于2026年7月1日归档，因此API、浏览器、服务和evaluator漂移不会再由上游维护。
  • Croissant metadata的sha256字段是字符串main，不是content hash。21条attack JSONL是base goal，而非不可变84任务manifest；也没有发布canonical的successful、refused、hijacked-incomplete、failed、crashed、timed-out或retried rollout corpus。
  • WASP主体代码/数据采用CC BY-NC 4.0，vendored VisualWebArena与Claude demo组件采用MIT。自托管站点含有从真实网站抓取的数据；record-level provenance、consent、PII review与再分发权利为unknown。Curator inference：即使fresh replay成功，混合权利与lineage缺失仍阻止不受限训练或再分发。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, WASP is useful as an evaluation and audit reference because it binds a task/config record to a live web environment, an observation–action episode, and two non-equivalent feedback layers. A controlled study can distinguish refusal, intermediate hijacking, malicious partial progress, completed harm, benign-task failure, and disagreement between judge and environment predicates.

As a benchmark recipe, reconstruct the 84-task cross-product rather than treating the 21 Croissant attack rows as the full suite. Report ASR-intermediate, ASR-end-to-end, and utility together; stratify by site, goal category, injection format, scaffold, and action cap; and pin API model versions. Low terminal ASR without intermediate and utility results cannot separate robustness from agent incapability.

As a verifier-audit case, rescore the same trajectories with the fixed GPT-4o prompt/parser and alternative judges, then inspect action-level disagreements before any-positive aggregation. Separately test each DOM/log predicate against controlled positive, negative, stale-state, and partial-execution cases. The exfiltration rule should be compared with a receipt-based evaluator that verifies destination, secret completeness, and value validity.

As a release-audit case, bind every instantiated task and locally generated rollout to the base goal, benign goal, injection template, site snapshot, setup/cleanup result, model/scaffold settings, judge output, terminal-evaluator output, retry status, and checksum. Replace Croissant's sha256: main with content digests and record the archived commit, mixed licenses, and scraped-content provenance.

Reuse is safe for evaluation and audit only. The paper trains no models, the release has no canonical rollout corpus, and the accepted metadata does not support SFT, distillation, preference learning, reward modeling, RLVR, agent-policy training, or safety-alignment training. Training reuse and unrestricted redistribution remain blocked pending explicit author guidance, record-level rights, contamination analysis, immutable trajectories, and calibrated feedback.

对指定的environment_agent_trajectory_data track而言，WASP适合作为evaluation与audit参考，因为它把task/config记录连接到live web environment、observation–action episode及两个不等价的feedback layer。受控研究可区分refusal、中间劫持、恶意部分进展、已完成伤害、benign-task failure，以及judge与environment predicate之间的不一致。

作为benchmark recipe，应重建84任务笛卡尔积，而不是把21条Croissant attack记录当作完整套件。报告时同时给出ASR-intermediate、ASR-end-to-end和utility，并按站点、goal category、注入格式、scaffold与action cap分层，固定API model version。若不同时给出intermediate与utility结果，低terminal ASR无法区分鲁棒性和agent能力不足。

作为verifier-audit案例，可用固定GPT-4o prompt/parser与替代judge重评分同一批轨迹，在any-positive聚合前检查action-level disagreement；同时以受控positive、negative、stale-state与partial-execution样例分别测试每个DOM/log predicate。exfiltration规则应与receipt-based evaluator比较，后者需验证destination、secret完整性和值有效性。

作为release-audit案例，应把每个实例化task与本地生成rollout绑定到base goal、benign goal、注入模板、site snapshot、setup/cleanup结果、model/scaffold设置、judge output、terminal-evaluator output、retry状态与checksum。还应把Croissant的sha256: main替换为content digest，并记录归档commit、混合许可证和scraped-content provenance。

复用范围仅限evaluation与audit。论文没有训练模型，发布没有canonical rollout corpus，accepted metadata也不支持SFT、distillation、preference learning、reward modeling、RLVR、agent-policy training或safety-alignment training。在获得明确作者指导、record-level权利、contamination分析、不可变轨迹与calibrated feedback前，训练复用和不受限再分发均为blocked。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The canonical venue is NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track; the earlier ICML 2025 Workshop on Computer Use Agents appearance is not the publication record used by this Card.
  • Count the benchmark correctly: 21 attacker goals × 2 same-site benign goals × 2 task-related injection formats = 84 main tasks, plus 37 utility tasks; the release stores 21 base attack rows, not 84 canonical rollouts.
  • Read ASR-intermediate and ASR-end-to-end as different contracts: GPT-4o judges each action and any positive compromises the episode, while goal-specific DOM/log rules score completed harm.
  • The fixed exfiltration evaluator checks expected URL text in agent actions rather than confirmed attacker-server receipt; parser errors for the intermediate judge default to not_compromised.
  • Prioritize Paper §3.2–§3.4 for construction and metrics, Table 2 for model/scaffold results, Tables 3–4 for prompt/defense ablations, §4.2 for capability confounding, and the pinned evaluator files for implementation semantics.
  • Use WASP only for evaluation/audit: there is no canonical rollout corpus, no tag or release, the repository was archived on 1 July 2026, and Croissant's sha256 value main is not a content digest.

• canonical venue是NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track；更早的ICML 2025 Workshop on Computer Use Agents版本不是本卡采用的正式出版记录。
  • 数量必须按构造口径读取：21个attacker goal × 2个同站点benign goal × 2种task-related注入格式 = 84个主任务，另有37个utility任务；发布只有21条base attack记录，并非84条canonical rollout。
  • ASR-intermediate与ASR-end-to-end是不同契约：GPT-4o逐action判断且任一positive即可把episode标为compromised，按goal定制的DOM/log规则则评估伤害是否完成。
  • 固定exfiltration evaluator只检查agent action中的预期URL文本，不确认攻击者服务器收件；intermediate judge的parser报错会默认not_compromised。
  • 阅读时优先看论文§3.2–§3.4的构造与指标、表2的model/scaffold结果、表3–4的prompt/defense消融、§4.2的能力confounding，以及固定evaluator文件中的实现语义。
  • WASP仅应用于evaluation/audit：没有canonical rollout corpus、tag或release；仓库于2026年7月1日归档，Croissant的sha256值main也不是content digest。
